verses.en: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
verses.sm: Moapi ma Amoni ) Ua mavae ia mea, ona o mai ai lea o le fanauga a Moapi, ma le fanauga a Amoni, e faatasi ma i latou foi nisi o sa Amoni, e tau ma losefatu.

verses.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.
verses.sm: Ona o mai lea o isi, ma fai mai ia Iosefatu, ua faapea mai, O loo o mai le vao tagata e matuà toatele e tau ma oe, mai le la itu o le sami, mai Suria; faauta foi, o i Haseso Tamara i latou, o Enokati lea.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
verses.sm: Ona mataʻu ai lea o Iosefatu, ua ia faamalosi ai e sailiili i le ALII, ma ua tala‘iina e ia le anapogi ia Iuta uma.

verses.en: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto ai lea o Iuta e sailiili i le ALII; ua latou o mai foi mai aai uma o Iuta e sailiili i le ALII.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Iosefatu i le faapotopotoga o Iuta ma Ierusalema, i le fale o le ALII, i luma o le lotoa fou,

verses.en: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Le ALII e, le Atua o matou tama, e le o le Atua ea oe i le lagi? E te le pule ea oe i malo uma o nuu ese? E le o i lou aao ea le mana ma le malosi, e le mafaia e se tasi ona tetee atu ia te oe?

verses.en: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
verses.sm: E le o lo matou Atua ea oe, ña e tulia i latou sa nonofo i lenei nun i luma o lou nuu o Isaraelu, ma ua E foaiina mai ai i le fanau a Aperaamo lau uo e faavavau?

verses.en: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
verses.sm: Ua latou nonofo ai, ma fai ai mo oe le malumalu mo lou suafa, sa faapea atu,

verses.en: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
verses.sm: Afai e oo mai mea leaga ia te i matou, O le pelu, po o le sala, po o le faamai, po o le oge, ma matou tutu i luma o lenei fale, atoa ma ou luma, aua o i ai lou suafa i lenei fale, ma matou valaau atu ia te oe i lo matou puapuaga, ona e faafofoga mai ai lea, ma faaola mai.

verses.en: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia e sisila mai, o le fanauga a Amoni, ma Moapi, ma le mauga o Serra, o i latou na e le mafai ona tuu mai ia Isaraelu ia osofia i latou, ina ua latou o mai mai le nuu o Aikupito, a ua latou “alo ese ia te i latou, ma ua Je faaumatia i latou;

verses.en: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
verses.sm: silasila ia i latou, ua faapea ona latou taui mai ia te i matou, ua o mai e tutuli ia te i matou ai lou tofi na e foai mai mo i matou.

verses.en: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
verses.sm: Lo matou Atua e, e te le faamasino ea ia te i latou? Aua e leai so matou malosi e tetee i lenei vao tagata e toatele, ua o mai e tau ma i matou; ua matou le iloa foi se mea e fai; a ua faasaga atu i matou ia te oe.

verses.en: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.sm: Ua tutu Iuta uma i luma o le ALII, ma o latou tama iti, o a latou ava, ma a latou fanau.

verses.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
verses.sm: Ona oo mai lea o le Agaga o le ALII i luga o laaseelu i totonu o le faapotopotoga, o ia o le atalii o Sakaria, o le atalii ia o Penaia, o le atalii ia o Ieielu, o le atalii ia o Matania, o lo sa Levi, o lo le fanauga a Asafo;

verses.en: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not your's, but God's.
verses.sm: ua ia faapea atu, O outou Iuta uma, ma e ua nonofo i Ierusalema, ma oe le tupu o Iosefatu, ina faafogafoga mai ia outou, o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII ia te outou, Aua neʻi fefefe, aua foi neʻi matatau outou, ona o lenei vao tagata e toatele; aua e le o lo outou taua lenei, a o lo le Atua.

verses.en: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.sm: Ia outou o ifo taeao ja te i latou ; faauta, ua o ae i latou i le aega i Sesa; tou te maua foi i latou i le mea e taunuu ai le alia e feagai ma le vao o Ieruelu.

verses.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
verses.sm: E le tau outou i lenei taua; tutu ia outou, ma ia outou tumau, ma outou Vaai atu i le olataga mai le ALII o loo ia te outou; Iuta ma Ierusalema e, aua le fefefe, aua foi le matatau; ia o atu taeao ia te i latou; e ia te outou foi o le ALII.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona punou lea o Iosefatu i lalo i le eleele; ua faapati foi Tuta uma ma e ua nonofo i Ierusalema i luma o le ALII, ua ifo atu i le ALII.

verses.en: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
verses.sm: O sa Levi, o le fanauga a sa Koato, ma le fanauga a sa Koru, ua tutu i latou e vivii i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu i le leo tele ma le maualuga.

verses.en: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
verses.sm: Ua latou ala tulai i le taeao, ma o atu i le vao o Tikoa; o loo o atu i latou, ona tu atu lea o Iosefatu, ua faapea atu, Iuta e, ma outou e nonofo i Ierusalema, faalogologo mai ia ia te au. Ina faatuatua ia i le ALII lo outou Atua, ona faatumauina lea o outou; ia outou faatuatua i ana perofeta, ona outou manuia ai lea.

verses.en: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.sm: Ua ia filifili ma le nuu, ona tofia lea e ia o e pepese i le ALII, ma e vivii atu ua ia i latou teuga paia, i lo latou o atu i luma o ‘au, ma latou fai atu, Ia faamanu atu i le ALII, aua e faavavau lona alofa.

verses.en: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
verses.sm: Ua latou amata ona pepese ma vivii atu, ona tuu atu lea e le ALII o “au ua tanu e tau ma le fanauga a Amoni, ma Moapi, ma le mauga o Seira, na o mai e tau ma luta; ua fasia i latou.

verses.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.sm: Aua na tulai le fanauga a Amoni ma Moapi e tau ma e nonofo i le mauga o Seira, e matua fasioti ma faaumatia ai i latou; ua uma ona latou fasia o e nonofo i Seira, ona fefasiai ai lea o i latou.

verses.en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu Iuta i le ‘olo e leoleo ai ua i le vao, ona latou vaavaai atu ai lea i le vao tagata, faauta, O i latou o tagata oti, ua taatitia i latou i le eleele, ua leai se sao.

verses.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.sm: Ua o mai Iosefatu ma lona nuu e vete mai a latou mea, ona latou maua lea ia te i latou o oloa e tele i tino o tagata oti, atoa ma teuga matagofie, ua latou to ese mo i latou, ua le mafai ona laʻu; o aso e tolu o vete ai le oloa ina ua matua tele ia.

verses.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.sm: O le aso fa na latou faapotopoto ai i le vanu o Peraka; aua na latou faamanu i le ALII i lea mea; o le mea lea ua faaigoa ai lea lava mea, o le vanu o ! Peraka ua oo mai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.sm: Ona foi mai lea o i latou, o tagata uma o luta ma lerusalema, ma Iosefatu na muamua io latou luma e toe foi i Jerusalema ma le fiafia, aua ua faafiafiaina i latou e le ALII i e na ita mai ia i latou.

verses.en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua latou o mai i Ierusalema ma napeli, ma kitara, ma pu, i le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.sm: Sa i ai le mataʻu i le Atua i malo uma o ia nuu, ina ua latou faalogologo na tau le ALII ma i latou e ua ita mai ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
verses.sm: Sa toalemu le malo o Josefatu; aua na tuuina mai le filemu ia te ia e lona Atua i itu uma.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.sm: Ua fai Iosefatu ma tupu ia Iuta. E tolu sefulu ma le lima ona tausaga ina o fai o ia ma tupu; na fai foi o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema i tausaga e lua sefulu ma le lima. O Asopa le igoa o lona tina, o le afafine o Seleki.

verses.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.sm: Na savali o ia i le ala o Asa lona tama, na le alu ese ai o ia; na faia e ia o mea tonu i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
verses.sm: A ua le aveeseina o mea maualuluga; aua o ona po ia ua le saunia ai e le nuu o latou loto i le Atua o latou tama.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e losefatu, o mea muamua ma mea mulimuli, faauta, ua tusia i le tala a Ieu le atalii o Hanani, ua ta‘ua i le tusi i tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
verses.sm: Ua mavae ia mea, ona faatasi lea o Iosefatu le tupu o Iuta ma Aasaia le tupu o Isaraelu o le na fai amio matua leaga.

verses.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.
verses.sm: Na ia faatasi ma ia e fai vaa ai, e 6i Ta~ sesa; na latou fai vaa i Esiokape.

verses.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.sm: Ona vavalo lea o Elisara, le atalii o Totava o le Maresa, ia Iosefatu, ua faapea atu, Ua faamalepeina e le ALII au galuega, ina ua e faatasi ma Aasaia. Ona lepetia lea o vaa, ua le mafai ai ona
